item.sweet_plum_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with sweet plums originating from the banks of the Dorn Green Blood*=
item.sweet_plum_wine.text2: §o——With a lower intensity, the taste is smooth as silk.
item.barley_wine.text1: §6§o=*Crafted from exquisitely brewed barley cultivated in the Riverlands*=
item.barley_wine.text2: §o——Country folk hoard this vintage, reserved for the uncorking ritual when guests of honor arrive—the first sip bites with bitterness, the second blooms with sweetness
item.lemon_juice_wine.text2: §o——Sweet as a maiden’s kiss, a single sip lightens the heaviest heart
item.frog_wine.text1: §6§o=*The dark green liquid is bubbling and you can see what looks like frog limbs floating on the surface*=
item.frog_wine.text2: §o——No one knows how this evil liquid was invented, and it even emits a fragrance and... frog sounds? Maybe you're hallucinating
item.oats_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with fresh oats from the Reach and infused with slivers of onion*=
item.oats_wine.text2: §o——A humble vintage born of country hearths—neophytes reel from its dragonsfire bite, yet swiftly succumb to the velvet embrace of its opulent depths
item.barley_oats_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed from fresh barley and oats of the Reach, with a touch of onion*=
item.barley_oats_onion_wine.text2: §o——The interweaving of barley and oats from the Riverlands imparts a dense, foamy texture, while the addition of onion petals enhances the flavor's complexity
item.barley_pepper_horseradish_wine.text: §6§o=*Brewed from Dorne’s heatwave barley and peppers, with horseradish*=
§o——The gritty sensation of Dornish green peppers, complemented by the bitterness of aged horseradish, leaves a lingering, mouth-watering aftertaste
item.barley_oats_pepper_wine.text1: §6§o=*Distilled from the Westerlands' gilded barley and oats, tempered with a whisper of emerald firepepper*=
item.barley_oats_pepper_wine.text2: §o——A common beverage in the Westerlands; the inclusion of green peppers is a recent innovation
item.barley_oats_plum_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with King's Landing barley and oats, with plums added*=
item.barley_oats_plum_wine.text2: §o——Frequently served at royal events in King’s Landing, this wine, though lacking in complexity, commands a high price
item.barley_horseradish_leek_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Red Mountain Coast barley and horseradish, with leeks added*=
item.barley_horseradish_leek_wine.text2: §o——A staple among Redshore Coast residents; the local horseradish imparts a lingering aroma at the back of the throat
item.barley_nettle_pepper_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Westerlands barley and ash peppers, laced with nettle*=
item.barley_nettle_pepper_wine.text2: §o——A common farmhouse brew in the Westerlands, nettle leaves are added to balance the bitterness of green peppers, making it easy to produce
item.barley_oats_horseradish_wine.text1: §6§o=*Crafted from Storm's End barley and oats, enhanced by fiery horseradish*=
item.barley_oats_horseradish_wine.text2: §o——The moist climate of Storm’s End melds the rich aromas of barley and oats, with a hint of horseradish grass creating a subtle, lingering finish
item.barley_chickpea_oats_wine.text1: §6§o=*Crafted from King's Landing barley and stone-ground chickpeas, mingled with oats*=
item.barley_chickpea_oats_wine.text2: §o——A chilled wine commonly found in the homes of King’s Landing residents; the blend of aged chickpeas and oats offers a bone-chilling coolness that invigorates the spirit
item.barley_pepper_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Crafted from Westerlands barley and peppers, layered with onion essence*=
item.barley_pepper_onion_wine.text2: §o——A wine found in Casterly Rock, but due to the improper mix of onions and Westerlands green peppers, it has piled up in warehouses—few dare to drink it
item.barley_onion_plum_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Storm's End barley and onions, softened with plums*=
item.barley_onion_plum_wine.text2: §o——Beloved in Storm’s End; the addition of southern sweet plums renders the aftertaste enduring, like sweet dew refreshing the heart
item.barley_oats_lemon_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Reach barley and storm-tossed oats, zested with lemons*=
item.barley_oats_lemon_wine.text2: §o——The blend of barley and chickpeas from the Riverlands, harmonized with lemon, is nothing short of ambrosia
item.chickpea_lemon_nettle_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed from Winterfell's chickpeas and lemons, laced with a sting of wolfsbane nettle*=
item.chickpea_lemon_nettle_wine.text2: §o——With a brief summer in Winterfell, wines are aged deep in cellars, imparting a woody, barrel-aged character
item.chickpea_oats_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Dragonstone chickpeas and oats, with a pinch of onion added*=
item.chickpea_oats_onion_wine.text2: §o——A rare wine from Dragonstone; the onion-infused brew offers a honeyed, lingering sweetness
item.chickpea_pepper_nettle_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Blackwater chickpeas and fire peppers, infused with stinging nettle*=
item.chickpea_pepper_nettle_wine.text2: §o——The swampy aroma of Blackwater Bay combines with the spiciness of green peppers, while nettle bitterness balances the flavor—like drinking fire in a marsh
item.chickpea_horseradish_nettle_wine.te: §6§o=*Brewed with Iron Islands chickpeas and horseradish, with a hint of nettle*=
§o——The Iron Islands’ sea saltiness envelops horseradish’s fieriness, with nettle leaves slicing the throat like a blade—a burning sensation favored by Drowned God worshippers
item.chickpea_lemon_horseradish_wine.tex: §6§o=*Distilled with Storm Islands chickpeas and bitter lemons, sharpened by horseradish*=
§o——The Stormlands’ sea breeze brings lemony freshness that clashes with horseradish’s pungency, creating an intense flavor profile
item.chickpea_onion_leek_wine.text1: §6§o=*Distilled with King's Landing chickpeas and sharp onions, threaded with leeks*=
item.chickpea_onion_leek_wine.text2: §o——The bustle of King’s Landing permeates the wine; onions’ pungency and leeks’ wildness clash within the creamy chickpea base
item.chickpea_oats_leek_wine.text1: §6§o=*Distilled with Dragonstone chickpeas and black oats, seasoned with leeks*=
item.chickpea_oats_leek_wine.text2: §o——A common Dragonstone wine; the roasted aroma of black oats intertwines with the grassy scent of leeks, enveloping the palate
item.oats_onion_horseradish_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed from Storm’s End oats and onion, with some horseradishes*=
item.oats_onion_horseradish_wine.text2: §o——Horseradish’s bite and onions’ sweetness intertwine, crafting a uniquely spicy flavor characteristic of Storm’s End
item.oats_chickpea_nettle_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with oats and chickpeas from the Riverlands, plus some nettles*=
item.oats_chickpea_nettle_wine.text2: §o——The Riverlands’ unique fermentation techniques impart a subtle grassy aroma to the wine
item.oats_leek_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Forged from White Harbor's oats and leeks, steeped in a knight’s ransom of onions kissed by harbor-mist brine*=
item.oats_leek_onion_wine.text2: §o——A spicy wine brewed under White Harbor’s sea breeze, offering a refreshing entry and a lasting finish
item.oats_horseradish_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with southron oats and pungent fire-root from beyond the Wall's shadow, blended with a touch of white harbor onions*=
item.oats_horseradish_onion_wine.text2: §o——The addition of sweet plums imparts a rich fruity aroma, making it perfect for slow sipping on winter nights
item.oats_chickpea_plum_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Reach oats and chickpea, with some plums added*=
item.oats_chickpea_plum_wine.text2: §o——The opulence of the Riverlands transforms into honeyed plum sweetness, with chickpeas and oats wrapping the palate like silken layers in the Golden Rose courtyard
item.oats_leek_plum_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with White Harbor oats and salt-kissed leeks, sweetened with plums*=
item.oats_leek_plum_wine.text2: §o——White Harbor leeks, soaked in sea mist, whisper with sweet plums, while the oat aroma is as precious as a captain’s last sip of honey wine
item.oats_chickpea_lemon_wine.text1: §6§o=*Distilled with Reach oats and sun-baked chickpeas, brightened by lemon tang*=
item.oats_chickpea_lemon_wine.text2: §o——The Highgarden sun-ripened lemon falls into the Riverlands’ grain waves, with chickpeas’ steadiness supporting this golden, dazzling nectar
item.oats_nettle_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Riverlands oats and stinging nettle, tempered with white onions*=
item.oats_nettle_onion_wine.text2: §o——Riverlands nettles’ venom lurks within oats’ warmth, with onion’s spice erupting like the Tullys’ sudden vengeance
item.oats_pepper_nettle_wine.text1: §6§o=*Crafted from Storm Islands oats and wild peppers, spiced with nettle*=
item.oats_pepper_nettle_wine.text2: §o——Stormlands thunder hides within green peppers’ folds, with nettle leaves entwining oats’ richness like godswood vines pressing onward
item.oats_chickpea_pepper_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Stormwood oats and chickpeas, with green peppers added*=
item.oats_chickpea_pepper_wine.text2: §o——Greenfield’s grain wines are renowned for their delicacy; this one is famed for its green pepper seasoning
item.onion_lemon_nettle_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Storm Islands onion and lemons, with nettle added*=
item.onion_lemon_nettle_wine.text2: §o——A harmonious fusion of three ingredients: initially spicy, but with a particularly refreshing aftertaste
item.pepper_lemon_leek_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Stormwood peppers and brine-kissed lemons, blended with marsh leeks*=
item.pepper_lemon_leek_wine.text2: §o——Greenfield’s pepper’s edges are smoothed by lemon, while leek leaves’ wildness transforms into spring meadow morning dew within the wine
item.pepper_leek_nettle_wine.text1: §6§o=*Brewed with Northern fire peppers and winter leeks, blended with wild nettle*=
item.pepper_leek_nettle_wine.text2: §o——Frost-kissed peppers gain sweetness, giving the wine a unique northern aroma
item.pepper_nettle_onion_wine.text1: §6§o=*Crafted from Riverlands fire peppers and nettle, anchored by onion bite*=
item.pepper_nettle_onion_wine.text2: §o——A formula cherished by Riverlands vintners, perfect for pairing with rich meats
